en.s1: Growth diverging — labor demand cooling while aggregate output remains positive (NFP +57k, GDPNow 5.9%, agg hours YoY +0.9%, consumption solid). Inflation above target, energy upside risk, but breadth measures materially lower (Trimmed Mean PCE 2.2%, Median CPI 2.7% → gap 0.81pp — consistent with less broad-based pressure, though positive price skew means trimmed readings are not yet definitive evidence of disinflation), market lifting 10Y inflation expectations (breakeven +5bp MoM) (Core PCE 3.3%).
en.s2: Labor cooling but not crashing: claims low, payrolls +57k (net change — gross hiring needs JOLTS confirmation). Unemployment 4.2%, little changed. Sahm Rule 0.07pp (trigger=0.50). Drivers: fiscal neutral to mildly expansionary, supply-side / energy cost pressure.
en.s3: Markets primarily pricing higher real rates, with a modest rise in inflation compensation. 10Y +27bp MoM (TIPS +22bp, breakeven +5bp) → real rates driving yield rise (inflation compensation contributed a minor share). Model estimates term premium at 0.84% and rising over past month. Credit stable (HY-IG 206bp).
en.s4: Key risks & contradictions: easy financial conditions vs persistent core inflation — constrains Fed cut room; GDPNow estimates 5.9% but payrolls only +57k — growth-employment divergence needs confirmation from total hours & GDP components.

zh.s1: 增长信号分化——劳动需求降温但总体产出仍正（NFP +57k，GDPNow 5.9%，总工时YoY +0.9%，消费尚可）。通胀高于目标，能源价格带来上行风险，但广度指标明显较低（Trimmed Mean PCE 2.2%，Median CPI 2.7% → 差距0.81pp——与通胀压力较集中一致，但价格分布正偏时trimmed mean可能低估真实趋势，尚不能确认通胀已全面缓解），市场通胀预期上升（盈亏平衡+5bp）（核心PCE 3.3%）。
zh.s2: 就业降温但未崩坏——初请仍低，非农净增+57k（净增≠招聘率，仍需JOLTS数据确认）。失业率4.2%，变化不大。Sahm Rule 0.07pp（触发线0.50）。驱动力：财政立场中性偏松、供给侧/能源成本压力。
zh.s3: 市场主要交易长端利率上升（主要由实际利率推动，同时通胀预期小幅回升）。10Y月变+27bp（TIPS +22bp，盈亏平衡+5bp）→收益率上升主要来自真实利率，通胀预期仅贡献小部分。 模型估算期限溢价处于高位（0.84%），近期仍在上升。（注：期限溢价为纽约联储ACM模型推算，非直接可观察值。）信用市场仍稳定（HY-IG 206bp）。
zh.s4: 最大矛盾与风险：金融条件宽松但核心通胀持续——限制降息空间；GDPNow估算5.9%但非农仅+57k——增长与就业背离，需总工时及GDP分项数据确认。
